items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: Gerry Mulligan sometimes would have bands where it was just Chet Baker and bass and drums.

ctx.x: Did you find that you play differently without a chordal instrument? And is it necessarily that you play more because you feel like you need to fill the space?

That’s a good question. I don’t feel like I need to fill the space. You do feel more free, like you might just be very melodic. You might be very quote conservative. You’re going to play this old time standard but you can let it sort of like ring out. Think of Sonny Rollins. And he did “We Kiss in a Shadow” on “East Broadway Rundown.” He just played that beautiful, beautiful melody and it’s just with bass and drums on that particular track, and it’s just like ahh. So I kind of like, now we’re talking as a…
I’ve had some interesting responses to the question are there wrong notes in improvising.
